### A Prayer for When Your Life Seems Overwhelming
Author: Betsy de Cruz
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-when-your-life-seems-overwhelming.html
Passage: Joshua 22:5
Points:
- Juggling competing responsibilities often leaves believers anxious, overwhelmed, and distracted.
- When life feels cluttered, Scripture directs believers to step back and reorder their primary callings.
- Joshua exhorted the weary tribes that their foremost assignment was to love God and cling to Him wholeheartedly.
- Filtering personal success through loving and serving God brings clarity and peace to frantic routines.
- Praying for God-centered priorities helps simplify our days and align our desires with His will.

### Used By God
Author: Greg Laurie (Harvest Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-may-2-2005-1326597.html
Passage: Joshua 22:5
Points:
- Surrendering to Jesus completely redirects a believer's life and priorities.
- Salvation awakens a deep desire to redeem past lost time and pursue a closer walk with God.
- Joshua's charge to the returning tribes outlines the call to walk in God's ways and hold fast to Him.
- Serving God and letting Him guide our daily steps brings unparalleled joy.
- Being invited into God's work to share the gospel is the highest privilege imaginable.
